entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

intro.zh: 给 AI Agent 装上「屋里最懒的资深工程师」思维：动手前先问一句，这段代码真的需要存在吗。装上后，Agent 更倾向用最少代码解决问题——比如日期选择器直接上原生输入控件，而不是装组件库再写包装层。作为 Claude Code 等编码 Agent 的技能安装即用。
intro.en: A skill that gives your AI agent the instincts of the laziest senior dev in the room: before writing anything, ask whether the code needs to exist at all. With it, your agent reaches for a native input instead of installing a component library and a wrapper. Installs as a skill for coding agents like Claude Code.

cardLine.zh: 让 AI Agent 少写代码的编码技能，逼它先问「真需要吗」
cardLine.en: A coding skill that makes your agent write less code

entries.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

intro.zh: 一套给编码 Agent 用的工程体系：让 Agent 先规划再动手、用测试验证改动、换个干净上下文自查、记住关键信息，并把反复奏效的做法沉淀成可复用技能。装一次就融进日常流程，不用在每个提示词里重复交代。目前对 Claude Code 支持最好，也为 Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等提供适配。
intro.en: An engineering system for coding agents: it makes the agent plan before building, verify changes with tests, review its own work from a fresh context, remember what matters, and turn repeated wins into reusable skills. Install once instead of re-explaining the process in every prompt. Best supported on Claude Code, with adapters for Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more.

cardLine.zh: 给编码 Agent 装上规划、记忆、自审与安全扫描的工程化体系

fitFor.zh: 想让 AI 扮演明确职能角色的个人与团队
fitFor.en: Individuals/teams wanting role-specialized agents

fitFor.zh: 管理咨询、营销等多职能场景的小团队
fitFor.en: Small teams spanning consulting, marketing and more

entries.quickstart:
# msitarzewski/agency-agents
$ git clone https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents.git
$ cd agency-agents
# 具体安装与运行方式请参考仓库 README
entries.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.

intro.zh: 一整套「AI 员工」人设合集：前端高手、Reddit 社区运营、脑洞注入者、现实检查员等，每个智能体都有明确的身份、工作流程和交付物，不是泛泛的提示词模板。可以只挑需要的团队装进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等工具，也提供桌面应用一键浏览与安装。
intro.en: A roster of AI specialist personas — frontend wizards, Reddit community ninjas, whimsy injectors, reality checkers — each with its own identity, workflows and expected deliverables rather than a generic prompt template. Install only the teams you need into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others, or browse the roster in a desktop app.

cardLine.zh: 可装进编码 Agent 的 AI 专家人设合集，按团队挑选
cardLine.en: A roster of installable AI specialist personas for your agent
